name: Plugin Card
description: Draggable, resizable card widget that wraps plugin content. DOM: .card > .card-header (.card-title-area > .card-title-text, .card-controls with minimize/fitview/terminate buttons) + .card-body + .card-edge (east/south/southeast resize handles). Drag snaps to 28px grid via transform-aware world→screen coordinate conversion. Resize enforces 280px minimum (10 grid units). Header double-click triggers fitViewport. Right-click header opens context menu. UUID generated via crypto.randomUUID(). Drag/resize handlers registered on document mousemove/mouseup with cleanup on remove().

interface.constructor: new PluginCard(parent: HTMLElement, opts: CardOptions, getTransform: () => { scale: number; panX: number; panY: number })

methods.name: renderTitle
methods.description: Update title text in card header

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Replace body content with HTML string

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Clean up document-level event listeners, fire onDestroy, remove DOM element

properties.name: opts
properties.description: Configuration options including all event callbacks

properties.name: onDestroy
properties.description: Callback fired during remove() before DOM cleanup
